description.value: Brodeur's Bistro is a sit-down restaurant in Langley, BC, serving a distinctive blend of Montreal and New Orleans cuisine including poutine prepared multiple ways. It operates as a full-service bistro with table reservations, a beverage and happy hour menu, and online ordering. Touring cyclists looking for a hearty regional meal in the Langley area will find it a solid stop.
